description: This file is a Perl module ('metadata.pm') that provides functions and data structures for parsing and managing package and target metadata in a build or configuration system. It defines packages, functions to parse metadata files, and maintains internal data for packages, categories, user/group info, and targets.

methods.name: get_multiline
methods.description: Reads multiple lines from a filehandle until a line starting with '@@' is encountered, concatenating the lines with optional prefixing.

methods.name: confstr
methods.description: Replaces certain characters in a string with underscores to produce a configuration string.

methods.name: parse_package_metadata_usergroup
methods.description: Parses a user or group specification line and updates the corresponding hashes with IDs and names, checking for validity and conflicts.

methods.name: parse_target_metadata
methods.description: Parses a target metadata file to extract details about build targets, profiles, dependencies, and configurations, returning structured target info.

methods.name: clear_packages
methods.description: Resets all internal package, category, user, and group hashes to empty states.

methods.name: parse_package_metadata
methods.description: Parses a package metadata file to populate package, source, override, category, and user/group data structures.

methods.name: parse_package_manifest_metadata
methods.description: Parses a package manifest file to extract package details like version, dependencies, source information, and other metadata.
